report.tagline: The Tata Group's super-app that ties its brands together with one loyalty currency, NeuCoins, and a co-branded credit card.
report.simpleSummary: Tata Neu is one app where you can shop at Tata brands like BigBasket, Croma, Tata 1mg, Westside, Taj hotels and Air India. Every purchase earns NeuCoins, and one NeuCoin is worth ₹1 on your next purchase across these brands. A Tata Neu HDFC credit card gives extra coins. After big losses, Tata is now focusing the app on loyalty and financial products like loans and insurance.

overview.whatItDoes: Tata Neu brings Tata's consumer brands into one app with a single login, a shared loyalty programme (NeuCoins), payments (Tata Pay UPI) and a co-branded credit card. It launched in April 2022 with high hopes of becoming India's super-app. In 2025 and 2026, under CEO Sajith Sivanandan, it moved away from chasing sales volume toward loyalty, credit cards, loans and insurance, with major job cuts.
howItWorks: You sign up once and can shop across BigBasket, Croma, Tata 1mg, Tata CLiQ, Westside, IHCL hotels, Air India and more.
Each purchase earns NeuCoins, usually around 5% on Tata brands, more with the credit card.
One NeuCoin equals ₹1 and can be used across all Neu brands.
The Tata Neu HDFC credit card earns extra NeuCoins on Tata and other spends.
The app also offers UPI payments, personal loans, insurance and investments from partners.
Many brands still have their own apps, so Neu is often one of several ways to shop.
overview.valueProposition: For shoppers: earn and spend one loyalty currency across many trusted Tata brands. For Tata: know customers across brands, sell more to each, and earn from credit and financial products.

businessModel.summary: The Neu app itself earns from credit card partnership fees, financial product commissions and brand marketing. Most Tata Digital revenue comes from selling goods through Croma and BigBasket, which lose money.

revenueStreams.detail: Sales of products; the bulk of the ₹35,990 crore revenue.
Share of interchange and fees from HDFC.

businessModel.pricing: App is free. NeuCoins: 1 coin = ₹1. Tata Neu Plus and Infinity HDFC cards carry annual fees (about ₹499 and ₹1,499), often waived on spend.
businessModel.unitEconomics: On a ₹1,000 BigBasket order through Neu, the customer might get about ₹50 in NeuCoins, which BigBasket or Tata Digital pays for. BigBasket already loses money on many orders, so loyalty adds cost. A credit card customer spending ₹40,000 a month may earn Tata a share of interchange, maybe ₹100 to ₹200 a month, which is why the card and financial services are now the focus.

growth.moat: Tata Neu's moat is the Tata brand and the spread of Tata businesses, from groceries to flights. No rival owns so many trusted brands. But the moat only works if users actually prefer Neu over each brand's own app.

pmLessons: Super-apps are hard: users like focused apps that do one job well.
Bundling brands is not enough; there must be a clear user reason to come to one app.
Loyalty is a cost; it must change behaviour enough to pay for itself.
Financial services often become the money maker for consumer super-apps.
